brand.title: GuardSchool
stats.title: TV statistics
stats.introShort: See who currently has a screen page open at your school. Green — the screen talked to the server recently, red — quiet for a long time, gray — the page has not been opened since the server started.
stats.detailsLead: This list is not saved when you click Save in the admin UI: it lives in the server memory only and clears after a restart. One screen row can show several devices (TV, phone, PC). If you open several tabs in the same browser, they merge into one row — tabs share one client id. With no polls for over a minute, a device disappears from the list.
stats.openScreens: Open the public screen picker on a new TV or phone (no admin password): /screens
stats.agoLegendShort: “Last poll” colors: green — under 30s, yellow — 30s to 2 min, red — over 2 min.
stats.statusOk: The screen responded recently (within three poll intervals)
stats.statusStale: No response for a long time — check power, network, and URL
stats.statusNever: This screen has not been opened since the server started
stats.noClients: No clients recorded yet (open a TV page in a browser).
stats.historyLead: Same devices as above; newest poll first. “On-air” time is approximate since the last gap longer than a minute.
stats.historyEmpty: No entries in the log yet.
programSettings.title: Program settings
emergencyTemplates.title: Templates when global emergency mode is on
emergencyTemplates.intro: With “Emergency mode” checked, all TVs show the selected template (text, colors, shared sound, image per screen name). Buttons next to the checkbox save the choice immediately.
emergencyTemplates.emptyHint: No templates. Add one or restore the built-in set.
emergencyTemplates.confirmRestore: Replace all templates with the built-in set (Fire, Anti-terror, Bomb threat, Emergency)? Your custom templates will be removed.
emergencyTemplates.confirmDelete: Remove this template from the list?
w.emergencyLocalImageHint: In normal mode these fields are used. With a global template, the image comes from Program settings → per TV name.
programSettings.paletteHint: Unchecked hides a type only in the compact list under the “Widgets” heading (Configure). TV and the preview grid stay the same. To edit a hidden block, enable its type again here.
top.demoBanner: Temporary demo session (you used a /demo/… link), not a normal school admin login. For the live admin: use “Exit demo”, then sign in at /login with your school administrator credentials.
top.filePickerHint: The file-picker button label comes from the browser/OS and may not match the admin UI language.
regional.title: Language, time & timezone
regional.offsetHint: Added to wall-clock time on TVs if device clocks drift. Range ±720 min.
preview.noScript: Screen module (screen_widgets.js) is not loaded. Reload the page or check script order in index.html.
preview.emptyWidgets: No visible widgets to preview (all disabled or hidden by carousel). Enable widgets in their settings.
screen.name: Name
screen.ipNotePh: Where the display is installed (not stream IP)
screen.classesEmpty: Upload Excel first to load classes.
screen.bellTemplateTip: Bell schedule source for this TV (lesson start/end).
screen.tvHint: Speakers/PA — use the PC audio panel, not this card.
bg.title: Background & readability
bg.fileTip: Single background file → uploads; used when rotation is off.
bg.rotateTip: When on, images are taken from the selected uploads folder on an interval.
bg.folderTip: Under data/uploads/<folder>. Folders appear if they contain at least one image.
bg.intervalTip: How often to change background when rotation is on. 3600 = 1 hour.
bg.nextTip: Switches to the next image and resets the rotation timer.
bg.outlineTip: Text shadow outline for readability on bright photos. 0 = off.
bg.galleryHint: Gallery: click to pin a background (turns rotation off).
bg.galleryEmpty: No images in this uploads folder.
widgets.title: Widgets
w.emergencyHint: Full-screen overlay above other widgets. Grid size is forced to full screen.
w.imageRotate: Image change interval, sec (0 = first with URL only)
w.imageHint: Browse uploads to uploads/widget_images, separate from TV backgrounds. Multiple images rotate on a timer; at 0 only the first non-empty URL is shown. Low opacity places the layer under other widgets.
w.charsPerMinHint: Marquee speed in characters per minute (reading-style metric). Cycle length is computed from text length: longer text → longer cycle at the same CPM. Typical ranges: primary ~120–180, upper grades ~200–300. Allowed 20–900.
w.speedSecLegacyHint: Used only if «Characters per minute» is empty: one full animation cycle in seconds (legacy). Does not scale with text length.
lesson.stats: Loaded rows: by date — {{d}}, full week — {{f}}, sample — {{s}}.
schedule.helpHtml: By date — columns Date, Class, Lesson1… or data/import/schedule.xlsx. Weekly — weekday, class, lessons; full_schedule.xlsx in import. Sample — diff vs full → highlight on TV. Priority: manual override → sample → dated/full.
schedule.importLead: Files in data/import are picked up automatically; here you upload manually.
schedule.zipFoot: Archive contains full_schedule.json, schedule_sample.json, full_schedule_sample.xlsx template, README.txt. At least one JSON is enough to import.
schedule.overridesLead: Override for a specific date, class and lesson number.
schedule.subject: Subject
bells.title: Bells
bells.templateFoot: If you set last lesson (e.g. 5), start/end bells for higher lesson numbers are skipped — so lesson 6 does not “start” after 5.
bells.rowsHint: Lesson field: digits only (1–8…) tie to Excel columns; text without a lone digit = extra interval (break, line-up…). On screen, minutes are filled in if the phrase has no digits.
preview.title: Template preview
preview.hint1: Same data as the TV: schedule, bells, holidays (server uses current screen fields even before Save).
preview.hint2: Drag blocks with the mouse. Shift+drag resizes.
history.title: Versions & changelog
audio.title: PC audio
audio.hint1: On TV — browser audio. On PC — ffmpeg (WASAPI) or ffplay. Save config after changes.
audio.hint2: End of lesson — “end” time in the row and end sound (or template default).
audio.playerHint: Only files from data/break_music — break preview. Bells are configured under Lessons & bells and play automatically on the PC.
audio.enable: Enable scheduled bells and (optional) break music
audio.hint3: Without the checkbox, background bells on PC stay off.
audio.useSchedule: Follow bell schedule of selected screen
audio.useBellFiles: Use bell sound files from admin (lesson start/end)
audio.hintVol: Break music volume — slider in the player panel on the right; bell volume — number field in the settings grid on the left.
audio.breakQueueHint: Scheduler state; updates with the status line.
audio.bellWindowHint: Same as bell_audio.trigger_sec_window for TV. Quick test: Settings → PC speaker / TV.
alert.oneScreen: At least one screen must remain.
alert.screenNoSlug: This screen has no slug — cannot open the TV URL.
alert.oneCarousel: At least one carousel must remain.
bells.soundsIntro: First click “Choose bell file” and upload mp3/wav to the server. Then pick files in the “Start sound” and “End sound” dropdowns for each interval (and in the defaults below if needed).
alert.oneBellTemplate: At least one bell template must remain.
history.lead: This list is the release log only: each entry must include a version number. Lines like “saved bell templates” are not part of it (legacy rows without version in data/change_log.json are hidden).
history.empty: No entries with a version number yet. On first run data/change_log.json is created; on each release bump APP_VERSION and append an object with version, timestamp, and message.
alert.importWeek: Week import done. Full: {{full}} rows, sample: {{sample}}.
audio.noBreakFiles: No files: put music in data/break_music (break music).
audio.noFileName: Selected track has no file name.
audio.statusTimeout: (Could not get status within a minute — see GuardSchool console.)
w.emergencySoundHint: Looped audio. Plays only when the global emergency mode is enabled and this screen checkbox is on.
preview.pcAudio.header: Server: {{serverTime}} | TV: first {{tw}} sec of bell minute
preview.pcAudio.volumes: PC volume (ffmpeg): bells — {{vpBell}}%; break music & fade — {{vpBr}}%.
preview.pcAudio.orchIntro: PC: break orchestration — music and “next lesson start” bell in the last minute before class; disabled during class.
preview.pcAudio.orchMorning: PC: before first lesson — background may play up to {{minutes}} min before the “start” bell; music stops in class.
preview.pcAudio.orchLesson: PC: class now — break scenario inactive (music only on breaks and morning window).
preview.pcAudio.tvMissed: TV ✖ missed: row {{idx}} {{bellKindLabel}} {{hm}} — sec {{secs}} ≥ {{tw}}. Increase window in PC audio.
preview.pcAudio.tvPassed: TV: row {{idx}} {{bellKindLabel}} {{hm}} — window passed (first {{tw}} s of minute).
preview.pcAudio.pcPhaseEndLesson: PC phase: “end of lesson” until {{headEnd}} (~{{remainSec}} s)
preview.pcAudio.pcPhaseStartLesson: PC phase: class start until {{T}} (~{{remainSec}} s)
preview.pcAudio.breakTooShort: PC: break too short for scenario (<30 s).
preview.pcAudio.breakNoGap: PC: could not match break interval (check bell template rows).
preview.pcAudio.pcBellPlay: PC ▶ bell: row {{idx}} {{bellKindLabel}} ({{tw}} s window, same as TV)
